note: The publication plan requires the pre-site identity set to be a subset of the final set: no identity may disappear. This file is that set, recorded once. It is historical and is never regenerated -- regenerating it from a later tree would make the check compare the present against itself.
pre_site_commit_subject: Publication plan, revision 2: the planning baseline before Phase 0

renames.adjudicated_note: Reviewer confirmed from the historical diff that 90d3fbe broadened coverage from one never-committed role to the complete role set and fixed the probe, so no test was lost.
renames.why: The test policed one role, generated-run-state. Phase 2 added generated-site-output, which must also never be committed, and the test was widened to police the set. It gained an assertion that every declared never-committed role is claimed by a component, and its probe was corrected: it asked git check-ignore about a bare directory path, which reports an unmaterialised location as unignored, and now asks about a file inside. Coverage strictly increased; only the name changed.
